items.material_issue: Narrative facts, actors, quantities and causal chain are preserved; deviations are stylistic (e.g. "Army of Rogues"→"游击军", "peace"→"胜利", "Horde"→"部落").
items.evidence: Key figures survive intact: "increased twenty-fold"→"提高到原来的二十倍", "thirty times the previous amount"→"30倍的价钱"; Iron Throne/Iron Council kept distinct as 钢铁王座/钢铁议会; "manipulated the king into mining it and selling it to them for a fraction of its true worth"→"利用这个国王去开采并将蓝锆石以一个极低的价格卖给他们".

items.material_issue: Quantity placeholder, the three-timeline framing and the choice prompt are all preserved.
items.evidence: "lived %d turns in three different timelines"→"在三条不同的时间线里度过了 %d 个回合"; "Which do you choose to be the real timeline?"→"你选择哪一条作为现实时间线？"

items.material_issue: Polarity and meaning of the reversal ("No" + life is still worth living) are preserved.
items.evidence: "No actually, perhaps life is still worth it!"→"不，其实生命或许依然值得活下去！" keeps the negation and the hedge "perhaps"→"或许".

items.material_issue: Speaker, referent and incredulity are preserved; the only loss is that the orb was the means of travel, which the immediately following mention of the Orb of Many Ways recovers.
items.evidence: "That you used to travel here from Maj'Eyal?"→"你说你是从马基·埃亚尔来的？" (instrumentality dropped); "Surely you don't possess the Orb of Many Ways!"→"你拿到的肯定不是多元水晶球！" retains the disbelief; "It's been lost for ages!"→"它已经消失很多年了！"

items.material_issue: Speaker, direction of the transaction and the dismissive tone are preserved; "原料" only makes the implicit referent of "these" explicit.
items.evidence: "take these and give you your undeserved reward"→"收下这些原料、把你不配得到的奖励给你" — the NPC still receives the items and hands over the reward; "%s has already finished"→"%s已经完成了".

items.material_issue: Speaker, the cries heard, and the euphemism about the guards being "in my way" are all rendered literally.
items.evidence: "I heard some cries, and your men... they were in my way."→"我听到了呼喊声，而你的人……挡了我的路。"; "What's going on here?"→"这里发生了什么事？"

items.material_issue: The talent's usage condition is rewritten: English states a single either/or requirement, while the Chinese adds an extra mandatory precondition (Gestalt must be active) and recasts "psionic damage shield active" as "not on cooldown". A player would believe an unstated requirement must also be met.
items.evidence: Source: "either a psionic damage shield active or Improved Gestalt available" (A active OR B available). Target: "必须在格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中时" = Gestalt active AND (shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown); "格式塔处于激活状态" has no counterpart in the source, and "active" is shifted from the shield onto Gestalt.

items.material_issue: Action, timing and the trailing placeholder are preserved; "竞技场" only names the location the player is entering.
items.evidence: "You take a look at the ranking boards before entering.\n%s"→"进入竞技场前，你查看了一下排名榜。\n%s", with the #LIGHT_GREEN# tag and %s intact.

items.material_issue: Speaker's recognition, the referent (the apprentice mage) and the location are preserved; dropping "I met" is implied by the recognition itself.
items.evidence: "You're that apprentice mage I met in the wilds!"→"你不就是那个荒野之中的法师学徒么？"; "Hold on!"→"打住！"

items.material_issue: Cost, currency and placeholder are unchanged.
Origin, creators, Spellhunt survival condition, unlock condition and the race feature list are all conveyed accurately.
items.evidence: "created (and subsequently abandoned) by the Conclave during the Allure Wars, to serve as their warriors and workers"→"在厄流战争中，孔克雷夫创造了食人魔作为工人和战士，但最后他们成为了被遗弃的种族"; "only those who fled to Shalore lands survived extermination"→"只有那些逃去永恒精灵领地的少量族群幸免于难"; "You can now create new Ogre characters"→"你可以创造新的食人魔角色".

items.material_issue: Dates, log numbering, speaker's contempt, and every test-subject outcome are preserved in order and content.
items.evidence: "Test subject M: Survived first transition. Imploded 2 seconds after."→"在第一次传送中存活，2秒后体内发生爆裂"; "Test subject N: ... in coma. Died after 4 days."→"但昏迷不醒，于4天后死亡"; "Age of Allure 4544/4545/4546"→"厄流纪 4544/4545/4546年"; race name 夺心魔 is used consistently for the big-headed servant race described ("oversized heads"→"大得过分的脑袋").

items.material_issue: Speaker, the construct's unfinished-but-functional state, its purpose, and the remaining step are all preserved.
items.evidence: "While it remains unfinished, it is finished enough to serve in its purpose of protecting my lair"→"虽然尚未彻底完成，却已经足以履行守卫我巢穴的使命"; "once it is complete it will be nigh invulnerable"→"等到它完全完成，更将近乎无敌"; "all that remains is to animate my newest minion and bend it to my will"→"只剩唤醒我最新的仆从、使其屈从于我的意志".

items.material_issue: Both placeholders, the rival's achievement, the cause of delay and the threat to the speaker's position are preserved; "一瓶" merely supplies a classifier for the created item.
items.evidence: "in your overlong absence, %s has managed to create a %s"→"在你离开的漫长时间里，%s已经设法配制出了一瓶%s"; "I'll be most put out if he steals my rightful spot."→"要是他抢走了本该属于我的席位，我可会非常不悦。"
